common.conflictBody: Someone changed this while you were working. What you typed is still in the form. Reload to see the latest version, then add your changes again.
common.networkError: The upload did not finish. Please check your internet and try again.
common.fileTooBig: The file is bigger than {max} MB. Please choose a smaller file.
common.fileTypeNot: This type of file is not accepted. Please use: {types}.
common.requiredNote: Only the product code is needed to save a draft. The rest is needed before you send it for review.

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.intro: Add your suppliers and their products here. Buyers in Malaysia can then find them and send you requests.

next.addSupplier: Start here: add your first supplier. MITRA reviews it before its products can be shown to buyers.
next.waitSupplier: Your supplier is waiting for MITRA's review. You can add products once a supplier is approved.

home.actionsTitle: What would you like to do?

gate.noProfileBody: MITRA needs a few details before your organisation can start. After you save them, MITRA will review and approve them.
gate.displayNameHint: For example, the name on your business card.
gate.contactEmailHint: MITRA uses this to reach you about your organisation. It is not shown to buyers.
gate.askOwner: Please ask the owner of this organisation to fill in these details.
gate.profileSaved: Saved. MITRA will review your organisation.
gate.pendingBody: Your organisation has been received. You can use the suppliers, products and import pages once MITRA approves it. You do not need to do anything else right now.
gate.suspendedBody: MITRA has paused your organisation. Your products are not shown to buyers, and you cannot add or change anything until it is resumed.

steps.p1: Check that your organisation name and contact email are correct in Settings.
steps.p2: Wait for MITRA's decision. You will get a notification here.
steps.p3: If it takes more than a few working days, contact MITRA support.
steps.s1: Read the reason above, then contact MITRA support to talk about it.
steps.s2: When MITRA resumes your account, everything comes back as it was.

settings.title: Settings
settings.displayNameHint: This name is shown to MITRA. Buyers see the supplier name, not this.
settings.staffIntro: People you invite can help you manage suppliers, products and buyer requests. Staff with the viewer role can only look.
settings.languageBody: You can read this site in English, Tamil or Bahasa Melayu. Choose your language in your account, or use the language links at the top of the page.

kinds.partner_decided: MITRA made a decision about your organisation.
kinds.supplier_decided: MITRA made a decision about one of your suppliers.
kinds.supplier_suspended: One of your suppliers was paused.
kinds.product_decided: MITRA made a decision about one of your products.
kinds.product_suspended: One of your products was paused.
kinds.sourcing_received: A buyer sent you a request.
kinds.sourcing_reply: A buyer replied to your question.
kinds.other: There is an update for you.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.intro: A supplier is the business that makes or sells the products. You add its details and papers, and MITRA reviews them.
suppliers.readOnly: You can look at suppliers but not change them. Ask the owner for a different role.
suppliers.emptyBody: Add your first supplier to begin. You will need its basic details, a contact person and at least one document.
suppliers.needsAttention: MITRA wrote to you about this supplier. Open it to read what to change.
suppliers.revisionInReview: Your changes are being reviewed. The approved version stays visible to buyers.
suppliers.unsentChanges: You have changes that have not been sent for review.
suppliers.unsentChangesLong: You have changes that have not been sent for review yet. Buyers still see the approved version.
suppliers.notEditable: This supplier cannot be changed right now. If it is waiting for review, wait for the decision or take it back from the supplier page.
suppliers.sent: Sent. MITRA will review this supplier and you will get a notification.

explain.draft: This supplier is a draft. Finish the four steps and send it for review.
explain.awaiting_review: MITRA is reviewing this supplier. You will get a notification when there is a decision.
explain.approved: MITRA reviewed this supplier. You can add products for it.
explain.rejected: MITRA did not approve this supplier. Read the reason below. You can fix things and send it again.
explain.more_info_needed: MITRA needs more information. Read what was asked below, update the supplier and send it again.
explain.suspended: This supplier is paused. Its products are not shown to buyers.

suppliers.reasonRevision: What MITRA wrote about your last changes
suppliers.reasonInfo: What MITRA asks you to add or fix
suppliers.liveStaysNote: If you change an approved supplier, buyers keep seeing the approved version until MITRA approves your changes.
suppliers.withdrawHint: Take it back if you want to change something before MITRA decides.
suppliers.withdrawn: Taken back. You can edit it again.

fields.name: Supplier name
fields.capabilities: What the supplier makes or does

suppliers.privateNote: These details are only for you and MITRA reviewers. They are never shown to buyers.
suppliers.docsNote: A document you add is only seen by you and MITRA reviewers. Adding a document does not mean it has been checked by MITRA or by any authority.

s1.title: Supplier Information
s1.codeHint: A short code you will also use in catalogue files, like KUMAR-01. Leave it empty and we will make one.
s1.name: Supplier name
s1.nameHint: The business name that buyers will see.
s1.stateCityHint: For example Tamil Nadu or Chennai.

s2.title: Capabilities
s2.descriptionHint: In a few sentences: what they make, how long they have been doing it, how they work. At least 20 characters.
s2.capabilities: What the supplier makes or does
s2.capabilitiesHint: One thing per line, up to 10. For example: Cotton sarees, Block printing, Export packing.

s3.title: Evidence and Authorization
s3.privacy: Contact details are private. They are only for you and MITRA reviewers, and are never shown to buyers.
s3.contactHint: Give an email, a phone number, or both.
s3.registrationHint: Only if you have it. It is private.
s3.notSure: I am not sure or I do not have one
s3.docsIntro: Add at least one document that shows the supplier exists, for example a business registration, a tax paper or a trade reference. Only you and MITRA reviewers can see them.

s4.title: Review and Submission
s4.intro: Check the details below. When you send it, MITRA will look at the supplier and your documents.
s4.privateNote: The contact person and registration number are private and are not shown to buyers.
s4.missingTitle: Still needed before you can send it
s4.approvedNote: This supplier is already approved. Your changes will be reviewed, and buyers keep seeing the approved version until then.
s4.alreadyUnderReview: This supplier is already with MITRA for review.

missing.name: The supplier name (step 1)
missing.description: A description of at least 20 characters (step 2)
missing.contact: A contact person with an email or phone number (step 3)
missing.document: At least one document that passed the file check (step 3)

docs.locked: sent for review, cannot be removed
docs.pendingHint: The file is waiting for the safety check. It will be ready soon. You cannot send the supplier for review until at least one file has passed.
docs.fileHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
docs.uploadedPending: Uploaded. The file is waiting for the safety check.
docs.notVerification: Uploading a document does not mean it is checked. MITRA reviews the documents after you send the supplier for review.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Your products, by supplier. Buyers only see a product after MITRA approves it and you publish it.
products.readOnly: You can look at products but not change them. Ask the owner for a different role.
products.emptyBody: Add a product one by one, or upload many at once from a spreadsheet.

revision.approved: New version approved, ready to publish
revision.inReviewLong: A new version is being reviewed. The version buyers see stays the same until you publish the new one.
revision.approvedLong: The new version was approved. Publish it to show it to buyers.
revision.otherLong: The new version was not approved yet. Read the reason, change it and send it again.

products.unsentChanges: You have changes that have not been sent for review.
products.needSupplier: You need an approved supplier before you can add products. Add a supplier first, and wait for MITRA to approve it.
products.notEditable: This product cannot be changed right now. If it is being reviewed, wait for the decision.
products.sent: Sent. MITRA will review this product and you will get a notification.
products.publishedNow: Published. Buyers can now find this product.
products.unpublishedNow: Unpublished. Buyers can no longer find this product. You can publish it again later.

explain.draft: This product is a draft. Fill in the details, look at the preview and send it for review.
explain.submitted: MITRA is reviewing this product. You will get a notification when there is a decision.
explain.approved: MITRA approved this product. Publish it when you want buyers to see it.
explain.changes_requested: MITRA asks for changes. Read the note below, edit the product and send it again.
explain.rejected: MITRA did not approve this product. Read the reason below.
explain.published: Buyers can find this product now.
explain.unpublished: This product is hidden from buyers. You can publish it again.
explain.suspended: MITRA has paused this product. It is hidden from buyers.

products.reasonChanges: What MITRA asks you to change
products.suspendedNoReason: MITRA did not give a reason. Please contact MITRA support.
products.editKeepsLive: If you edit this product, buyers keep seeing the current version until the new version is approved and you publish it.
products.supplierNotApproved: The supplier of this product is not approved at the moment, so the product cannot be shown to buyers.
products.submitHint: Send the product to MITRA to review. You cannot change it while it is being reviewed.
products.publishHint: Publishing makes the product visible to buyers.
products.unpublishHint: Buyers will no longer see this product. You can publish it again later.
products.noRevisions: Nothing has been sent for review yet.

productForm.skuHint: Your own product code. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes. It cannot be changed later.
productForm.name: Product name
productForm.descriptionHint: What it is, what it is made of, what it is good for.
productForm.currencyHint: Prices are shown as you type them. MITRA never converts currencies.
productForm.priceMode: How do you give the price?
productForm.requestNote: Buyers will see "Price on request" and can ask you for a price.
productForm.confirmedHint: The date you last checked this. It cannot be in the future.

tiers.title: Prices by quantity
tiers.hint: Each range starts right after the one before it. The last range has no upper limit. The first range must start at or below your smallest order.
tiers.toHint: Leave empty for no upper limit.

variants.title: Options (colour, size and so on)
variants.hint: Only if the product comes in options. Each option needs a label and its own code.
variants.label: Label
variants.attributesHint: One per line, like Colour: Red

specs.title: Specifications
specs.hint: Facts buyers look for, like Material, Weight or Size. Up to 20.

media.visibility: Pictures are shown to buyers only after they pass the file check and MITRA approves the product with them. Until then only you can see them here.
media.waitingAlt: Picture waiting for the file check
media.altHint: A few words for people who cannot see it, like: Red cotton saree folded on a table.
media.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Up to 8 pictures.
media.uploadedPending: Uploaded. The file is waiting for the safety check, so it is not shown yet.

preview.title: Preview as a buyer
preview.banner: This is a preview. Buyers will see this only after MITRA approves the product and you publish it.
preview.noName: Product name not filled in yet
preview.noImages: No picture has passed the file check yet.

import.title: Import Catalogue
import.intro: Add many products at once from a spreadsheet. Nothing is published automatically: every product becomes a draft first.
import.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Nothing was added.
import.step1Body: Fill in one row per product. The first row is an example you can replace.
import.templateHint: Use plain numbers for prices, like 250.50. Do not use formulas. Cells that start with = + - or @ are not accepted.
import.readOnly: You can look at imports but not start one. Ask the owner for a different role.
import.needSupplier: You need an approved supplier before you can import products.
import.supplier: Which supplier are these products for?
import.supplierHint: The supplier code in your file must be the code of this supplier.
import.modeCreateHint: Recommended. Rows with a product code that already exists are skipped and marked.
import.modeUpdate: Add new products and update existing drafts
import.modeUpdateHint: Product codes that already exist will be updated with the values in your file. You will be asked to confirm before anything changes.
import.fileHint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to 5 MB and 2000 products. The file is checked and not kept.
import.countsLine: {total} rows: {valid} fine, {invalid} with a problem, {duplicate} repeated.
import.repeatNote: You already confirmed this file earlier. Nothing was added twice.
import.doneBody: {created} products were added as drafts, {updated} drafts were updated and {skipped} rows were skipped.
import.draftsNote: These products are drafts. Nothing was published. Open each draft, check it, and send it for review.
import.submitHint: Importing never sends products for review for you. Open the drafts to send them.
import.failedBody: No row in this file can be imported. Download the list of problems, fix your file and upload it again.
import.confirmWithProblems: {valid} rows are fine and will be added as drafts. {problems} rows have a problem and will be skipped.
import.confirmAllGood: All {valid} rows are fine and will be added as drafts.
import.overwriteBody: You chose to update existing products. Please read this first.
import.overwrite1: Product codes that already exist are updated with the values in your file.
import.overwrite2: A value you leave empty in the file does not erase what is already saved.
import.overwrite3: The product codes that were changed are written to the activity record.
import.overwriteConfirm: I understand and I want existing drafts to be updated.
import.neverPublished: Nothing is published by this step.

errors.unknown: This value has a problem. Please check it.
errors.unknown_supplier: The supplier code is not the code of the supplier you chose.
errors.category_invalid: The category is not one we know. Use a name from the template.
errors.unit_invalid: The unit is not one we know, for example piece or kg.
errors.currency_invalid: The currency must be INR, MYR or USD.
errors.status_invalid: The status must be draft or submit.
errors.price_mode_invalid: The price option must be fixed, tiers or request.
errors.price_required: A price is needed unless the price is on request.
errors.price_mode_conflict: The price option does not match the prices given.
errors.decimal_invalid: Please use a plain number like 250 or 250.50.
errors.decimal_ambiguous: A comma in a number is unclear. Please use a plain number like 1250.50.
errors.decimal_too_many_places: Too many digits after the point (up to 2 for prices).
errors.moq_not_positive: The smallest order must be more than 0.
errors.price_not_positive: The price must be more than 0.
errors.out_of_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
errors.lead_time_order: The longest lead time cannot be shorter than the shortest.
errors.availability_invalid: The availability must be available, made_to_order, limited or unavailable.
errors.date_invalid: The date is not valid. Use 2026-12-01 or 01/12/2026.
errors.date_out_of_range: The date is too old or too far away.
errors.date_in_future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.specs_invalid: Write specifications as key: value; key: value.
errors.specs_duplicate_key: The same specification name is used twice.
errors.duplicate_sku: This product code appears earlier in the file. Only the first one is used.
errors.duplicate_variant: Two options have the same label.
errors.tier_incomplete: A price range needs a starting quantity and a price.
errors.tier_min_invalid: A price range must start at 1 or more.
errors.tier_range_invalid: A price range ends before it starts.
errors.tier_not_ascending: Price ranges must go from the smallest quantity to the largest.
errors.tier_overlap: Two price ranges cover the same quantities.
errors.tier_gap: There is a gap between price ranges. Each one starts right after the one before.
errors.tier_last_not_open: The last price range must have no upper limit.
errors.tier_qty_not_integer: Quantities in price ranges must be whole numbers.
errors.tier_open_ended_not_last: Only the last price range can have no upper limit.
errors.tier_currency_mismatch: The price range uses a different currency.
errors.orphan_child_row: This row on the Variants or PriceTiers sheet has a product code that is not on the Products sheet.
errors.unknown_variant: A price range names an option that does not exist.

fileErrors.import_unsupported_file: This file type is not accepted. Please use a CSV or an Excel (.xlsx) file made from the template.
fileErrors.import_too_large: The file is too big. Please keep it under 5 MB.
fileErrors.import_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows. Up to 2000 products at a time.
fileErrors.import_too_many_columns: The file has too many columns. Please use the template.
fileErrors.import_cell_too_long: A cell has too much text. Please shorten it.
fileErrors.import_malformed: The file could not be read. Please save it again as CSV or Excel and try once more.
fileErrors.import_bad_encoding: The CSV file is not in UTF-8. In your spreadsheet program, save it as "CSV UTF-8" and upload again.
fileErrors.import_formula_not_allowed: The file has formulas ({count} cells, for example {cells} on sheet {sheet}). Formulas are not accepted. Please paste values only and upload again.
fileErrors.import_empty: The file is empty or has no product rows.
fileErrors.import_missing_columns: The file is missing these columns: {columns}. Please use the template.
fileErrors.import_missing_sheet: The sheet {sheet} is missing. Please use the template.
fileErrors.orphan_rows: {count} rows on the Variants or PriceTiers sheets belong to a product code that is not on the Products sheet. Please fix them and upload again.

requests.title: Buyer Requests
requests.intro: Requests from buyers who want to buy your products. Answer new requests first.
requests.emptyBody: When a buyer sends a request for one of your published products, it will appear here and you will get a notification.

explain.submitted: This request is new. Read it, then say you got it or ask the buyer a question.
explain.acknowledged: You told the buyer you received this request.
explain.clarification_requested: You asked the buyer a question. You will be notified when they answer.

requests.privacyNote: You see the buyer's organisation name only. Contact details are not shared here.
requests.snapshotNote: This is what the buyer saw when they sent the request. If you change a price later, this does not change.
requests.tiersShown: Prices by quantity shown to the buyer
requests.noLongerListed: This product is not shown to buyers any more.
requests.respondBody: You can say you received the request, or ask the buyer a question first. This does not give a price or promise anything.
requests.noteHint: Needed when you ask a question (at least 5 characters). Optional when you acknowledge.
requests.cannotRespond: You can read this request but not answer it. Ask the owner for a different role.
requests.clarifySent: Your question was sent to the buyer.
requests.acknowledged: The buyer was told that you received the request.
